These files are byte-for-byte copies of public, tracked upstream test files.
Their original paths all start with crates/parser/tests/samples/:

Schnelle Notizen.one
  Git blob: 483150d0b520f70f1c04c2e38faff1ace15dd8db
  Used to verify that its genuine stored section name, "Scribbles", is not
  overwritten by a caller-provided friendly source filename.

No files from the separately AGPL-licensed joplin sample directory are included.
No user attachments, protected local notebooks, or private extracted text are
included in this directory. CAB archives assembled by tests are generated test
containers, not claimed to be real OneNote desktop exports.
